mapper.select: SELECT code AS "value", code_name AS "label", sort_order FROM tb_code WHERE grp_code = #{grpCode} AND use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY sort_order, code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_log (log_type, pgm_id, user_id, user_ip, log_dt) VALUES (#{logType}, #{pgmId}, #{userId}, #{userIp}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT dept_code, parent_code FROM tb_dept WHERE use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_file (file_id, ref_type, ref_id, ref_id2, ref_id3, file_name, file_path, file_size, content_type, sort_order, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{fileId}, #{refType}, #{refId}, #{refId2}, #{refId3}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{contentType}, #{sortOrder}, #{userId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT file_id, ref_type, ref_id, ref_id2, ref_id3, file_name, file_path, file_size, content_type, created_by FROM tb_file WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
SELECT file_id FROM tb_file WHERE ref_type = #{refType} AND ref_id = #{refId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_audit_log (trace_id, pgm_id, table_name, action, row_key, before_data, after_data, user_id, user_ip, audit_dt) VALUES (#{traceId}, #{pgmId}, #{tableName}, #{action}, #{rowKey}, #{beforeData}, #{afterData}, #{userId}, #{userIp}, NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT a.audit_seq, a.trace_id, a.pgm_id, a.table_name, a.action, a.row_key, a.before_data, a.after_data, a.user_id, a.user_ip, TO_CHAR(a.audit_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS audit_dt FROM tb_audit_log a
ORDER BY a.audit_seq DESC
